title: OpenMobile: Open-Source Mobile Agent Framework
summary: A comprehensive framework and dataset for training mobile agents to autonomously navigate and perform multi-step tasks in Android environments. It introduces a scalable task synthesis pipeline and policy-switching rollout strategies to improve agent performance and error recovery.
research_notes: Developed by Nanjing University and SenseTime; the release includes 34K action steps and tools for visualizing agent trajectories.

evolution.summary: Building on the grounding capabilities of the earlier SeeClick project, OpenMobile evolved into a full task-execution pipeline. As of 2026, fine-tuned versions using Qwen3-VL have reached state-of-the-art success rates on the AndroidWorld benchmark.
